name: CONNECTICUT DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION

name: MENTAL HEALTH & ADDICTION SERVICES CONNE
description: DMHAS IS RESPONSIBLE FOR IMPLEMENTING THE FOLLOWING: A. EXPAND ACCESS MENTAL HEALTH MODEL TO ADULTS I. ENSURE TIMELY AND EQUITABLE ACCESS TO PSYCHIATRIC CONSULTATION FOR ADULT PRIMARY CARE PROVIDERS (PCPS), PARTICULARLY THOSE SERVING RURAL AREAS. CONSULTATION ACTIVITIES PROVIDED WILL BE MULTIFACETED, INCLUDING BY PHONE, ZOOM, IN PERSON, WORKSHOPS, AND CASE CONSULTATIONS. CONDUCT A VARIETY OF OUTREACH ACTIVITIES TO ACHIEVE HIGH PROGRAM AWARENESS AND ENROLLMENT AMONG RURAL ADULT PCPS AND FAMILY PHYSICIANS. IMPROVE ACCESS TO MENTAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE USE SERVICES FOR ADULTS, PRIORITIZING RURAL AND UNDERSERVED AREAS. B. ADULT 23-HOUR CRISIS STABILIZATION UNITS (CSUS) I. ESTABLISH UP TO 4 ADULT 23-HOUR CSUS, INCLUDING TWO RESPITE BEDS IN EACH PROGRAM, AS A DIVERSION FROM HOSPITAL EDS. SITES WILL BE ESTABLISHED IN THE STATE’S RURAL AREAS, WITH THE POTENTIAL OF BEING LOCATED NEAR HOSPITALS IN THOSE AREAS. SERVICES PROVIDED INCLUDE SCREENING, ASSESSMENT, TREATMENT PLANNING, NURSING, MEDICATION MANAGEMENT, CLINICAL INTERVENTIONS, CASE MANAGEMENT, AND PEER SUPPORT. STAFFING INCLUDES PRESCRIBERS, NURSES, LICENSED INDEPENDENT PRACTITIONERS (E.G., LCSW, LPC), ASSOCIATE LICENSED STAFF (E.G., LMSW), PARAPROFESSIONALS, AND CERTIFIED PEER SUPPORT STAFF.
